name: OmaNotes
author: Suva
description: A quick-note scratchpad that docks to a screen corner. Toggle with a keybind or the bar icon; font size, note background color, corner, and the keybind itself are all configurable from an in-panel settings view. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle omanotes

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the OmaNotes note scratchpad
